# RelayWorks — Full Architectural & Studio Manifest

> RelayWorks is an independent boutique software engineering studio founded by Hazrat Ummar Shaikh. We architect, build, and ship production native mobile applications, high-concurrency backend microservices, custom platform automation (Discord & Slack), and domain-grounded conversational AI workflows.

- Domain: https://relayworks.dev

---

## 1. Native & Multiplatform Mobile App Development
URL: https://relayworks.dev/mobile-app-development

### Disciplines
- Android: Native Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines & Flows, Room Database, WorkManager, Foreground Services.
- iOS: Swift, SwiftUI, Combine, SwiftData / CoreData, BackgroundTasks framework.
- Multiplatform: Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), Compose Multiplatform, SQLDelight, Koin dependency injection, Ktor client.

### Architectural Standards
- Offline-First Architecture: Local-first SQLite/Room/SQLDelight storage with delta sync queue and deterministic conflict resolution.
- UI Fluidity: Strict 60FPS / 120FPS ProMotion rendering without jank or main-thread blocking.
- Clean Architecture: Distinct domain, data, and presentation layers for complete testability.
- App Store & Play Store Delivery: 100% store review compliance, signing keys, privacy manifests, and in-app purchase setups (RevenueCat / StoreKit 2 / Google Play Billing).

---

## 2. High-Throughput Backend & Microservice Architecture
URL: https://relayworks.dev/services

### Disciplines
- Frameworks: Kotlin Spring Boot, Ktor, Python FastAPI, Node.js / Next.js.
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis.
- Communication: RESTful APIs, WebSocket full-duplex channels, SSE (Server-Sent Events), RabbitMQ / Kafka message streaming.
- Infrastructure: Docker containerization, Linux VPS hardening, Nginx reverse proxy, CI/CD automated deployment with GitHub Actions.

---

## 3. Custom Discord Bots & Platform Automation
URL: https://relayworks.dev/discord-bot

### Disciplines
- Languages: Python (discord.py, nextcord)
- Bot Architecture: Cogs modular pattern, async command trees, Discord Slash Commands, Modals, Select Menus, Buttons.
- Capabilities: Automated moderation systems, private ticket lifecycles with HTML transcripts, multi-tier economy engines, Stripe / crypto payment verification webhooks, and game server integrations.
- Hosting: 24/7 uptime on hardened Linux VPS instances monitored via PM2 and health-check endpoints.

---

## 4. Conversational AI & Business Workflows
URL: https://relayworks.dev/ai-chatbot-development

### Disciplines
- Frameworks: FastAPI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude API, Gemini API.
- Vector Systems: pgvector, Pinecone, ChromaDB, hybrid BM25 + dense semantic retrieval.
- Grounding: Strict Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with deterministic guardrails eliminating model hallucinations.
- Omnichannel: Web interactive widgets, WhatsApp Business Cloud API integration, CRM database syncing (HubSpot, Salesforce, Supabase).

---

## Shipped Case Studies
1. Karigo (Field Operations SaaS): Zero-server local-first mobile invoice and rate engine built with Kotlin Multiplatform, Jetpack Compose, SQLDelight, and RevenueCat. (https://github.com/ihazratummar/Karigo-App)
2. Islam24 (Native Android Application): Ultra-low battery background engine (<1.5% daily) utilizing exact AlarmManager scheduling and FusedLocationProvider. Live on Google Play Store. (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hazrat.islam24)
3. OneDrop (Real-Time Healthcare System): High-throughput mobile client and Kotlin server handling real-time push broadcasts and atomic reservation locks for blood donors. (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hazrat.onedrop)
